import MilneLib.Affine.QuasiProjectiveOrbits
import MilneLib.Quotient.GaloisQuotientMorphisms

/-!
# Galois morphism descent from projective embeddings

Immersions into finite-dimensional projective spaces provide the affine
orbits needed by the canonical finite Galois quotient. This gives its Hom
equivalence directly from embeddings, without a separate orbit hypothesis.
This is an input to Milne III.1.13; quasi-projectivity of the quotient itself
is not asserted here.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace MilneLib.StableGroupAction.StableAffineOpen

attribute [local instance] MvPolynomial.gradedAlgebra

variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
  [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
  {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.IsSeparated] [Y.IsSeparated]
  [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y]
  (actX : (L ≃ₐ[K] L) →* Aut X) (actY : (L ≃ₐ[K] L) →* Aut Y)
  (pX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) (pY : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))
  (hactX : ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
    (actX g).hom ≫ pX = pX ≫ (specAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L g).hom)
  (hactY : ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
    (actY g).hom ≫ pY = pY ≫ (specAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L g).hom)

/-- Projective-space immersions supply the affine orbits for the canonical
Galois Hom equivalence. The embeddings need not respect the Galois actions. -/
noncomputable def finiteGaloisQuotientHomEquivOfImmersions
    (n m : ℕ)
    (iX : X ⟶ Proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) L))
    (iY : Y ⟶ Proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (m + 1)) L))
    [IsImmersion iX] [IsImmersion iY] :
    let b := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))
    let hXK := galois_action_comp_base actX pX hactX
    let hYK := galois_action_comp_base actY pY hactY
    let hX := orbitsInAffineOpen_of_isImmersion_proj actX n iX
    let hY := orbitsInAffineOpen_of_isImmersion_proj actY m iY
    let rX := (finiteStableQuotientBaseMapData actX (pX ≫ b) hXK hX).map
      (finiteStableQuotientCrossChartDatum actX (pX ≫ b) hXK hX)
    let rY := (finiteStableQuotientBaseMapData actY (pY ≫ b) hYK hY).map
      (finiteStableQuotientCrossChartDatum actY (pY ≫ b) hYK hY)
    (Over.mk rX ⟶ Over.mk rY) ≃
      {f : Over.mk pX ⟶ Over.mk pY // ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
        (actX g).hom ≫ f.left = f.left ≫ (actY g).hom} :=
  finiteGaloisQuotientHomEquiv actX actY pX pY hactX hactY
    (orbitsInAffineOpen_of_isImmersion_proj actX n iX)
    (orbitsInAffineOpen_of_isImmersion_proj actY m iY)

end MilneLib.StableGroupAction.StableAffineOpen
